column1: # DarkusShadow's overworld sprite sheets, the second source of Walking Pals (convert_walking_pals_nat.py, DARKUSSHADOW).
# Each file is the post's own image, fetched from DeviantArt on the date given, never scaled or re-encoded: a 256 x 256
# PNG (512 x 512 for Miraidon) of 4 rows by 4 frames, drawn at twice its pixels. Used only where PMD Sprite Collab has no
# sheet of its own (Blake, 2026-10-04: "use the ones i gave you if they fill in sprite collabs gap").
# Terms, from the posts and his "Gen 9 (Paldea) Pokemon Overworld Sprites" sheet: "This is free for everyone to use in
# their Pokemon projects! Please give credits if used!"; artists as his credits list and each post name them.
# sha256 is checked on every run. Chien-Pao, Iron Boulder, Iron Crown and Mega Malamar are byte for byte the sheets
